feat(durable): show typescript calls in host logs with a present field

pi-action reads an optional `present` field on pi-durable tools to show
their calls in the workflow log. The typescript tool's call view gives the
`// @pit:` label as the title and the program without its header, plus
params, functionId, and saveOnly; its result view summarizes the injected
functions (or the error's first line) and shows the returned value with
string fields as they are rather than escaped JSON.

Closes #372
